blocks.text: Lima: View of the main square and cathedral beneath the Peruvian flag

After breakfast, transfer to the airport and fly to Cusco.

On arrival, you will be met and taken to your hotel.

In the afternoon, set out to visit archaeological sites around the city.

Your first stop is **Sacsayhuamán**, a complex built in Inca times. According to legend, people from other tribes were barred from entering, and the complex was considered sacred and associated with the authority of the Inca ruler.

Next is **Qorikancha**, the Temple of the Sun. Built in the 15th century, the temple once had gold decorations in its interior and on its altar. After the Spanish arrived, part of the complex was destroyed and a convent was built over it. An earthquake later damaged the Spanish building, beneath which the massive Inca walls survived.

You will then see **Tambomachay**, a water temple and site of ritual bathing. Purpose-built channels carried water into the pools.

Nearby is **Puka Pukara**, or the Red Fort, an archaeological complex with defensive walls and towers.

After the tour, return to your hotel. Overnight in Cusco.

**Optional:** A visit to Cusco Cathedral before the main tour takes about 40 minutes and costs **$25**.
